phases.name: Early prototype
phases.changes: Initial random networks and five generations of selection. Binary observations of local terrain and traffic.

phases.name: Binary road learner
phases.changes: Binary hazard inputs; 200 chickens evaluated on 8 generated training maps per generation. Topology and connection weights evolved together.

phases.name: Lookahead branch
phases.changes: Inherited networks with distance, motion and two-hop hazard inputs. Experiments varied the observation layout, objective and mutation settings.

phases.name: Final memory branch
phases.changes: Two-hop lookahead plus the previous horizontal action. 100 chickens × 32 maps; row-based fitness, small weight mutations and a frozen final selection.
